capture_id.description: The capture id. Generated when the capture is created.

captured_amount.description: The captured amount in minor units.

captured_at.description: The time of the capture. Specified in ISO 8601.

description.description: Description of the capture shown to the customer.

klarna_reference.description: Customer friendly reference id, used as a reference when communicating with the customer.

order_lines.description: List of order lines for the capture shown to the customer.

reference.description: Internal reference to the capture which will be included in the settlement files. Max length is 255 characters.

refunded_amount.description: Refunded amount for this capture in minor units.
